package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
	"golang.org/x/net/html"
)

func menuCanonical(t *testing.T, body string) string {
	t.Helper()
	tree, err := html.Parse(strings.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("HTML parse failed")
	}
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := html.Render(&out, tree); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("HTML serialization failed")
	}
	return out.String()
}

func TestMenuOriginalAndActionDOM(t *testing.T) {
	var reference bytes.Buffer
	if err := MenuReference().Render(context.Background(), &reference); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if menuCanonical(t, reference.String()) != menuCanonical(t, menuSource) {
		t.Fatal("constant reference differs from original DOM")
	}
	var data Menu
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(menuDefaults), &data); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("defaults invalid")
	}
	if len(data.Links) != 3 || data.Submit == nil {
		t.Fatal("source defaults incomplete")
	}
	if _, err := NewMenu(data); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("blank action defaults accepted")
	}
	for i := range data.Links {
		if data.Links[i].URL != "" {
			t.Fatal("default invented destination")
		}
		data.Links[i].URL = []string{"/profile", "/help", "/license"}[i]
	}
	if data.Submit.Action != "" || data.Submit.CSRFName != "" || data.Submit.CSRFToken != "" {
		t.Fatal("default invented POST authority")
	}
	data.Submit.Action, data.Submit.CSRFName, data.Submit.CSRFToken = "/action", "csrf", "synthetic-menu-token"
	render := func(component templ.Component, err error) string {
		t.Helper()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal("valid fixture refused")
		}
		var out bytes.Buffer
		if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return out.String()
	}
	typed := render(NewMenu(data))
	enhanced := render(NewMenuEnhanced(data))
	// Check the deliberate structure changes directly, not a broad normalized diff.
	tree, err := html.Parse(strings.NewReader(typed))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	links, buttons, forms, fields := 0, 0, 0, 0
	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(n *html.Node) {
		if n.Type == html.ElementNode {
			attrs := map[string]string{}
			for _, a := range n.Attr {
				attrs[a.Key] = a.Val
			}
			switch n.Data {
			case "a":
				if links >= 3 || attrs["href"] != data.Links[links].URL {
					t.Fatal("link order or destination differs")
				}
				links++
			case "button":
				want := "button"
				if buttons == 1 {
					want = "submit"
				}
				if attrs["type"] != want {
					t.Fatal("button form semantics differ")
				}
				buttons++
			case "form":
				if attrs["action"] != "/action" || strings.ToUpper(attrs["method"]) != "POST" {
					t.Fatal("POST destination differs")
				}
				forms++
			case "input":
				if attrs["type"] != "hidden" || attrs["name"] != "csrf" || attrs["value"] != "synthetic-menu-token" {
					t.Fatal("CSRF binding differs")
				}
				fields++
			}
		}
		for c := n.FirstChild; c != nil; c = c.NextSibling {
			walk(c)
		}
	}
	walk(tree)
	if links != 3 || buttons != 2 || forms != 1 || fields != 1 {
		t.Fatal("action structure incomplete")
	}
	if strings.Contains(typed, "data-appkit-menu") || !strings.Contains(enhanced, "data-appkit-menu") {
		t.Fatal("enhancement scope leaks")
	}
	outputs := map[string]string{"reference.html": reference.String(), "typed.html": typed, "enhanced.html": enhanced}
	data.Label = strings.Repeat("Long menu label ", 10)
	for i := range data.Links {
		data.Links[i].Label = strings.Repeat("Long destination ", 15)
	}
	data.Submit.Label = strings.Repeat("Long action label ", 14)
	outputs["enhanced-long.html"] = render(NewMenuEnhanced(data))
	data.Submit.Disabled = true
	outputs["disabled.html"] = render(NewMenuEnhanced(data))
	data.Submit = nil
	outputs["links-only.html"] = render(NewMenuEnhanced(data))
	if menuOutput != "" {
		for name, body := range outputs {
			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(menuOutput, name), []byte(body), 0600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal("private output write failed")
			}
		}
	}
}
